items.text: I would pay for expanded public services, like housing, transit, and health care, with higher taxes on high earners and corporations.
California taxes are already too high. Government should live within its current budget, even if that means cutting some programs.
Apartment buildings should be allowed in neighborhoods that are currently zoned only for single-family homes.
Neighborhoods should have the final say over large new developments built near them.
Limits on how much landlords can raise rent each year should be expanded to more buildings.
Rent control discourages new housing and maintenance, and should be reduced.
My city should hire more police officers, even if that means less money for other services.
Cities should move some police funding to mental-health responders and violence-prevention programs.
People experiencing homelessness should be offered permanent housing first, without having to complete treatment beforehand.
Cities should clear encampments from sidewalks and parks, even when there aren't enough shelter beds for everyone.
California should phase out oil and gas drilling, even if it raises energy costs in the short term.
Environmental rules in California have gone too far and make gas, electricity, and housing too expensive.
The minimum wage should keep rising faster than inflation.
California should slow minimum-wage increases and new employer mandates to help small businesses survive.
Local police and jails should not help federal agents enforce immigration law.
State and local governments should cooperate fully with federal immigration enforcement.
Parents should be able to use public education funds at the school of their choice, including charter or private schools.
The growth of charter schools hurts traditional public schools and should be limited.
Access to abortion should be protected by law.
Schools should tell parents if their child asks to use a different name or pronouns at school, even if the child objects.
Gun laws should be stricter than they are now.
Law-abiding adults should be able to carry a concealed firearm without extensive restrictions.
California should create a single, government-run health insurance plan for everyone.
Private insurance and market competition are the best ways to keep health care affordable.
Cities should convert some car lanes and parking into bus lanes and protected bike lanes.
Road improvements for drivers should be a higher priority than new transit projects.
Voters should have to show a government-issued photo ID to vote, including by mail.
Every registered voter should automatically be mailed a ballot.
